question: How many hours of annual leave do I earn per pay period if I have worked for the federal government for 5 years?
expected_location: Types of leave › Annual leave
reference_answer: 6 hours per pay period (the rate for 3 to 15 years of federal service).

question: What is the maximum amount of annual leave I can carry over into the next leave year?
expected_location: Types of leave › Annual leave
reference_answer: 240 hours.

question: If I get called for jury duty, does it come out of my annual leave?
expected_location: Types of leave › Court leave (jury duty)
reference_answer: No. It is recorded as Court Leave, does not count against any other leave balance, and lasts as long as you serve on the jury.

question: How many days of sick leave can I use for bereavement or to attend a family member's funeral?
expected_location: Types of leave › Sick leave › For bereavement purposes › Civilian
reference_answer: Up to 13 days (104 hours) per year.

question: How much administrative leave can I get to be a bone marrow donor?
expected_location: Types of leave › Administrative Leave › Blood, bone marrow, and organ donation
reference_answer: Up to 7 days per calendar year (up to 30 days for organ donation).

question: When does award leave expire, and is it paid out if I leave?
expected_location: Types of leave › Award leave
reference_answer: It expires one year after it is issued (use it by the end of the pay period in which that date falls) and it is not paid out if you leave TTS.

question: Who has to approve a request for more than 80 hours of leave without pay?
expected_location: Types of leave › Unpaid leave
reference_answer: Written approval from your immediate supervisor and your Business Unit Director; then send the email thread to TTS-peopleops@gsa.gov.

question: I have been a federal employee for 8 months. Can I take paid parental leave?
expected_location: About PPL
reference_answer: Not yet: you need 12 months of federal service to use PPL (most veterans are eligible immediately).

question: After paid parental leave, how long do I have to commit to staying at work?
expected_location: About PPL
reference_answer: At least 12 weeks after your final day of PPL, whatever number of weeks you took.

question: What does the doctor's note need to include for birth-related paid parental leave?
expected_location: Requesting paid parental leave › After birth/placement › Birth-supporting documentation
reference_answer: Date of birth, diagnosis, prognosis, and duration of care.

question: How many weeks of unpaid FMLA leave can I take to care for my spouse, who is a seriously ill servicemember?
expected_location: About FMLA
reference_answer: Up to 26 weeks.

question: What do I need to be eligible to receive donated leave through the Voluntary Leave Transfer Program?
expected_location: To receive donated hours › Eligibility
reference_answer: All leave balances (annual, sick, award) exhausted, an anticipated negative balance of at least 24 hours, and a medical condition for you or a family member likely to keep you away 24 work hours or more.

question: How many credit hours can I have saved at one time, and do they expire?
expected_location: Credit hours, in flexible work schedules
reference_answer: Up to 24 credit hours; they roll over and never expire (paid out only if you leave GSA).

question: When does regular comp time expire?
expected_location: Overtime and Compensatory (Comp) time › Compensatory (Comp) time, depending on your salary level
reference_answer: One year (26 pay periods) after it is earned; after that it is forfeited.

question: On a Variable Day schedule, what is the most I can work in a single day?
expected_location: Schedule types and their relationship to overtime, holiday pay, and credit hours › Flexible schedule › Types of flexible schedules › Variable Day
reference_answer: 12 hours (and the days must add up to 40 hours a week).

question: Can I earn credit hours on a compressed schedule?
expected_location: Schedule types and their relationship to overtime, holiday pay, and credit hours › Compressed schedule
reference_answer: No, credit hours are not available on a compressed schedule.

question: How long does it take to get reimbursed after I submit a travel voucher?
expected_location: Brief overview of vouchers
reference_answer: The voucher is reviewed in 3 to 5 business days, and the money arrives 3 to 5 business days after approval.

question: I am taking a personal trip abroad. What do I have to do when I get back?
expected_location: Reporting Personal Foreign Travel › When You Return
reference_answer: Complete the Foreign Travel De-briefing form within five days of returning.

question: Can I connect my personal laptop to the GSA network when I am in a GSA office?
expected_location: Laptop › Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
reference_answer: No. Only approved smartphones and tablets can connect; personal laptops cannot connect directly to the GSA network at any GSA facility.

question: What are the rules for the passcode on my work iPhone?
expected_location: Phone › Rules
reference_answer: It must be longer than 14 characters, contain letters and numbers, and be known only to you.

question: How far in advance should I submit a leave request?
expected_location: Your overall responsibilities
reference_answer: At least three business days in advance.

question: How long do I need to be at my current GS level before I can apply for a promotion to the next grade?
expected_location: Introduction to the Merit Promotion process
reference_answer: One year (the time-in-grade requirement), met within 30 days of the job posting's closing date.

question: How much sick leave do I earn per pay period, and how many sick days can I use for family care before I need to apply for FMLA?
expected_location: Types of leave › Sick leave;How FMLA works › FMLA for caregiving and health reasons
reference_answer: 4 hours per pay period; up to 13 days a year for family care and bereavement, and beyond 13 days you can apply for FMLA.

question: I used 4 weeks of FMLA in the past year to care for my mother. How much paid parental leave can I still take, and how much FMLA will I have left?
expected_location: About PPL;How FMLA works › Paid Parental Leave and FMLA
reference_answer: PPL is implemented through FMLA, so the 4 weeks are subtracted: 8 weeks of PPL, and taking it uses up the remaining FMLA for the rolling 12 months.

question: I have used up all my sick leave because of a long illness. What are my options, and how much advanced sick leave can I ask for?
expected_location: Reasons someone can take leave;Introduction
reference_answer: Advanced annual leave, advanced sick leave, or donated hours through the VLTP; up to 240 hours of advanced sick leave (term employees: up to what they will earn in the rest of their term).

question: I am on a Variable Week schedule and normally work 10 hours on Thursdays. If a holiday falls on a Thursday, how do I cover the missing hours, and how many credit hours can I keep saved?
expected_location: Schedule types and their relationship to overtime, holiday pay, and credit hours › Flexible schedule › Holidays and flexible schedules;Credit hours, in flexible work schedules
reference_answer: You get 8 hours of holiday pay, so you make up the 2 hours another day or use annual leave, credit hours or comp time; you can hold up to 24 credit hours.

question: I am leaving TTS for a private company. Can I take leave on my last day, and what happens if I do not return my laptop?
expected_location: When it's time to leave TTS › 1. Email notice of your resignation › Taking time off prior to your last day at TTS;When it's time to leave TTS › 6. Return your equipment
reference_answer: The final day must be worked in full unless you worked most of your final pay period; if equipment is not returned, your final paycheck may be withheld.

question: When are the FY25 end-of-year performance awards issued, and if I pick award leave instead of money, what is the most I can get and how long do I have to use it?
expected_location: End of year performance review important dates;Types of leave › Award leave
reference_answer: Around December 10, 2025 (budget permitting); at most 80 hours of award leave per fiscal year, which expires one year after it is issued.

question: If I travel for work outside my normal hours, do I get comp time for it, and will it be paid out if I later leave GSA?
expected_location: Travel comp time, for everyone;When it's time to leave TTS › 3. Review your benefits
reference_answer: Yes, travel comp time for approved TDY travel outside regular hours; it is not paid out when you leave (it is forfeited).

question: How do I sign up for the transit subsidy, and which organization code do I enter?
reference_answer: The handbook only points to a separate transit benefit page and gives no enrollment steps; say the corpus does not cover it and suggest People Ops.

question: Which days are paid federal holidays for TTS employees, and how many are there in a year?
reference_answer: The handbook explains holiday pay by schedule but does not list the holidays; say it is not covered.

question: What is the per diem rate for meals when I travel to Chicago for work?
reference_answer: The handbook says Concur shows the per diem for the location but gives no rates; say it is not covered and point to Concur.

question: How much does the government match on my Thrift Savings Plan contributions?
reference_answer: The handbook only says employees can join the TSP and links to InSite; it gives no matching rate, so say it is not covered.

question: What is the salary range for a GS-13 position at TTS?
reference_answer: The handbook only gives the overall pay cap (GS-15 step 10); say GS-13 pay is not covered.

question: Does TTS pay a monthly stipend for my home internet when I telework?
reference_answer: The handbook only covers internet costs during official travel; say a telework internet stipend is not covered.

question: Does TTS offer a signing bonus or a relocation incentive to new hires?
reference_answer: Not covered by the handbook; say so and suggest asking HR.

question: What is the dress code when I work from a GSA office?
reference_answer: Not covered by the handbook; say so.
